name: Houdini MCP: Build Node Chain
description: Build a Houdini node network from a structured JSON spec in one validated, semantic pass. Spec shape: {intent, nodes:[{id, parent, type, name?, params?}], connections:[{from, to, out?, in?}], layout?, cook?}. Validates parents + ids before mutating Houdini; returns id-to-path map for downstream nodes. No rollback in Tier 1 — created paths are reported even on failure for manual cleanup.
